public/vendor/snowflake-logo.svg — the Snowflake logo on the film thumbnail (`--mark snowflake`)
==============================================================================================

WHAT IT IS
  The Snowflake mark (the crystal, with its ®) as published by simple-icons 16.36.0 (`siSnowflake`),
  in Snowflake's brand colour #29B5E8, which simple-icons records for it. Used by
  scripts/thumb-film.mjs, embedded AS SUPPLIED: never recoloured, re-traced or re-proportioned.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
  Extracted on 2026-11-02 from graphl-flow's simple-icons dependency (CC0-1.0). The only change is
  `fill="#29B5E8"` on the <svg> element: simple-icons ships its paths without a colour, and gives
  that hex as the brand's own. simple-icons records Snowflake's brand guidelines as
  https://www.snowflake.com/brand-guidelines/ .

  CC0 covers simple-icons' copy of the drawing. It does not cover the trademark: the logo is
  Snowflake Inc.'s.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
  Naming Snowflake in the title and narration is nominative use. Putting the LOGO on a video's
  cover can suggest Snowflake produced or endorsed the course, which is the use trademark owners
  reserve. Read Snowflake's current brand guidelines, and get permission where they require it,
  before publishing under it.

  TO BE COMPLETED BY THE OWNER before this is published:
    guidelines read on (date) : ...........................................................
    permission (if any)       : ...........................................................

  `--mark star` (the repo's own star-schema mark, film-starmark.png) needs none of this.
  This file is a design note, not legal advice.
